info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Antlerit Racket Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Antlerit Racket Detail Management API allows businesses to create and manage detailed specifications for Antlerit rackets within their product catalog. This API facilitates the addition of essential features, dimensions, and attributes associated with each racket model. Typical consumers include e-commerce platforms and inventory management systems, enabling seamless integration of product details into various sales channels. By utilizing this API, companies can enhance their inventory accuracy and improve customer experience through comprehensive product information.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create detailed information for an Antlerit racket. You can specify the characteristics and features of the racket during the creation process.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit details about the Antlerit Racket. It requires the user to provide necessary data in JSON format to create or update details effectively.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the details of the antlerit racket.

antlerit_racket_id.description: The unique identifier for the Antlerit racket.

quantity.description: The quantity of Antlerit rackets requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates if the request is a priority request.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the Antlerit racket.
